headline: PPFAS Mutual Fund reduces cash holdings below 10 percent
hook: Deploying cash into correcting market valuations
summary: PPFAS Mutual Fund has aggressively lowered its cash levels to 9.7% from a previous high of 24%, deploying the capital into equities as valuations correct. Recent portfolio additions include real estate major DLF and cash management firm CMS Info Systems. This deployment signals a more fully invested stance by one of India's prominent value-oriented fund houses. Retail investors tracking value investing strategies gain insight into where institutional capital is finding entry points.
whats_next: Monthly portfolio disclosure for the upcoming month
why_it_matters: Shows where large fund managers are deploying cash during market corrections.
winners_losers: DLF and CMS Info Systems gain / cash holders hurt
